verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Teams supports bots/agents that can be added to channels, respond to @mentions, use slash commands, and initiate/participate in conversations (ms-teams-docs-1, ms-teams-docs-6, ms-teams-docs-20, ms-teams-docs-28), which is the core mechanism for an AI agent to act as a channel participant triggered by mention. However, evidence is all first-party documentation with no independent/hands-on confirmation of the specific @mention-triggered conversational agent experience, and community feedback focuses on general Teams UX rather than this bot capability. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of mention-triggered agent participation, and clearer documentation specifically on adding an agent as a full channel 'member' versus an installed app/bot.
